question: Does the phone seed each night's 16-bit Fusion RNG from its wall clock, so that two nights started at the same wall-clock residue modulo 65 536 ms replay the same encounter sequence?
basis: packages/core/src/mechanics/rng.js: CRun.random is (state * 31415 + 1) mod 2^16, seeded from (short) System.currentTimeMillis() at frame load (decompile 2026-08-25)

apps/device/src/timed-start.js and modern-campaign-ports.js (c37362a): FNAF_START_PHONE_WALL_RESIDUE_MS places the Custom Night Start tap when the phone wall clock reaches the residue; a timed start refuses rather than falling back
night-anchor.js records the night's onsetPhoneWallMs from the helper's wallMs stamp

binding.name: k3
binding.dials: all ten at 20 via custom-night-calibration-v1, readback required

runs.label: night7-k3-twin-c
runs.role: control, 30 000 ms off the twins' residue

hostConditions: no other CPU-heavy host job while a run is live (a parallel seed census is stopped or finished first)

observables.startTap: custom-night.start event: tapPhoneWallMs, tapPhoneWallLow16, lateMs, uncertaintyMs
observables.encounters: eyehole-read.py on the retained video, one window per cycle at release + 1.0 + 10 c s, 2.6 s at 5 fps (release = HUD first + 2.433 - 0.070 s), cycles 0..41 or up to a death
observables.deathOrWin: executor terminal and video TERMINAL as in the k2 cohort

comparison.perPair: for each pair (A,B), (A,C), (B,C): cycles where both runs have an identified Withered read; agreement = same identity; disagreement = different identity or one identified and the other empty
comparison.twinSupport: clock seeding is SUPPORTED if A and B agree on every cycle both identified (at least 8 such cycles) while C disagrees with both on at least 3 of its jointly identified cycles
comparison.twinRefutation: NOT SUPPORTED if A and B disagree on 3 or more jointly identified cycles and their onset low-16 residues differ by at most 50 ms
comparison.otherwise: INCONCLUSIVE, with the onset residue difference reported: the tap-to-load jitter decides whether the twins could share a seed at all (one millisecond apart is a different seed)

exclusions: a run that never reaches the night, a refused timed start, a dial readback failure, or a helper/capture failure is excluded with its reason and the slot is re-run at the same residue; nothing is tuned between runs
modelUse: none for the verdict; seed matching against the model is analysis only and recorded separately
